Didn't expect that. It was approximately 4.5 billion years ago. Our Pluto came into existence. But being so small and so far away from the Sun, it's orbit was unstable, it was hardly elliptical unlike other planets. The chances of Pluto drifting away were so high with such a weak orbit. But Neptune, the closest planet to the Pluto, showed this effect known as Resource. It means, the orbits of Neptune and Pluto overlap each other at some point of time during their rotation. They are in 3:2 resonance means, for every 3 revolution of Neptune around the Sun, Pluto makes 2. This pattern made the orbit of Pluto a stable orbit and prevented it from drifting away. Thankyou Neptune.
